feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 26 June 2026 6:23am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Variable 3 to 5, gradually settling and increasing South or SW 5 or 6 later this morning and afternoon, possibly 7 for a time to south of island. Decreasing mainly South 4 or 5 tonight, occasionally 6 to west.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight, building moderate.


##Weather)##

Thundery showers soon clearing, mist and fog patches developing.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers, poor or very poor in mist and fog patches tomorrow.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 22°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
